subject.title: Bug: Agent outputs ~ tilde shorthand instead of full absolute file paths

question: Should OpenClaw's user-facing agent and tool-output paths keep the current compact `~`/`$OPENCLAW_HOME` display, switch to full absolute paths by default, or offer an explicit display preference?
rationale: Current code intentionally shortens home paths and prior work only fixed malformed shortening; changing the default is a UX/product policy choice with config-surface and compatibility implications.

options.title: Keep Compact Default
options.body: Preserve `~`/`$OPENCLAW_HOME` as the default and treat only malformed or non-copy-pasteable shortening as bugs.

options.title: Use Absolute Paths By Default
options.body: Change shared display helpers and agent prompt guidance so user-visible file references under home render as full absolute paths.

options.title: Add Explicit Display Preference
options.body: Add a documented setting or env var for users who want full absolute paths while keeping current defaults unchanged.

recommendation.title: Keep Compact Default
recommendation.body: Preserve `~`/`$OPENCLAW_HOME` as the default and treat only malformed or non-copy-pasteable shortening as bugs.

likelyOwner.reason: Peter introduced the central shortening behavior and appears most connected to the current display policy surface.
